method: One frozen batch of model probabilities, reused through the ordinary classifier and ticket-analysis entry points. Supplied reliability fields are inputs. Gold outcomes are used only for reporting.
limitations: Evidence references and verification flags are accepted as supplied. Original scale checks and inspection records were not independently retrieved.
No repeated normalized descriptions were found. Different anonymized vendor namespaces do not establish vendor independence across exports.
Inspection dates overlap prior collection periods, so this is not a prospective later-time evaluation.
The balanced sample does not establish precision at the natural prevalence of operational violations.
The weight gate verifies evidence and quantities. Its metrics measure the combined workflow rather than an improvement to the unchanged model.
